heading.title: Of the Practice in granting and revoking Probates and Letters of Administration

article.title: District Judge’s powers as to grant of probate and administration.
article.content: The District Judge shall have the like powers and authority in relation to the granting of probate and letters of administration and all matters connected therewith, as are by law vested in him in relation to any civil suit or proceeding pending in his Court.
article.html:
266District Judge’s powers as to grant of probate and administration.

Section 266 · Part IX · Chapter IV · page 75 of the Act

The District Judge shall have the like powers and authority in relation to the granting of probate and letters of administration and all matters connected therewith, as are by law vested in him in relation to any civil suit or proceeding pending in his Court.
